spans.text: הַיּוֹם, יוֹם חֲמִישִׁי בְּשַׁבָּת, שֶׁבּוֹ הָיוּ הַלְוִיִּם אוֹמְרִים בְּבֵית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ׃

לְמַנַצֵּחַ — Speaking to His nation, Hashem proclaims: "I took you out of Egypt and saved you through the desert and took You as a nation, but you do not follow My laws! If only You would listen to Me and not follow 'false gods,' I would fulfill all your requests!"
יְהוָה מֶלֶךְ גֵּאוּת מֶלֶךְ גָּאוּת — We await the time when the Kingship of Hashem will be recognized by all, evil will be washed away, and the Beis Hamikdash will be rebuilt and last forever.

בָּרְכִי נַפְשִׁי—Just by looking at Your amazing Creation, my soul calls out that You, Hashem, are the Source of it all! From great mountains to the rushing waters, everything that plants, animals, and humans need is there—in its right place and in its right time! מָה רַבּוּ מַעֲשֶׂיךָ יְהוָה, כֻּלָּם How—בְּחָכְמָה עָשִׂיתָ, מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ קִנְיָנֶךָ overwhelmingly great and numerous are Your works, Hashem; they demonstrate great wisdom, planning, and forethought. From the largest of Your creations to the smallest, You provide them with their needs and give them life. אָשִׁירָה לַיהוָה בְּחַיָּי, As long as I live, אֲזַמְּרָה לֵאלֹהַי בְּעוֹדִי as long as I am able, I will sing praises to Hashem; יֶעֱרַב עָלָיו שִׂיחִי and may He find my words pleasing; אָנֹכִי (by יִשְׂמַח חֲטָאִים בַּיהוָה experiencing) His salvation. And may יִתַּמּוּ—מִן הָאָרֶץ, וּרְשָׁעִים עוֹד אֵינָם sin cease from the earth and may the wicked be no more! (And thus may בָּרְכִי נַפְשִׁי אֶת everyone realize that) הַלְלוּיָהּ—You, Hashem are the Source of everything; happens, praise Hashem!
הַיּוֹם, יוֹם שִׁשִּׁי בְּשַׁבָּת, שֶׁבּוֹ הָיוּ הַלְוִיִּם אוֹמְרִים בְּבֵית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ׃
On Rosh Chodesh, add Tehillim Chapter 104:

blocks.en: The Majesty and Intricacy of the Creation Demonstrates the Power and Providence of Hashem!
